component.name: ALBIS
component.summary: ALBULA-style viewer for DECTRIS detector data

description.p: ALBIS is a free, open-source viewer for DECTRIS detector data, in the style of ALBULA. It opens HDF5 stacks, TIFF, CBF, EDF and MYTHEN acquisitions, follows a running experiment live, and runs on your own computer or on the machine that holds the data, viewed from a browser elsewhere.
Resolution rings follow the true detector geometry, zoomed-in pixels show their values, series can be summed or averaged, and figures export sharp for slides and papers.
